verdict.rationale: Codex documents the skill spec: a directory with SKILL.md that requires name and description, built on the open agent skills standard. It also ships meta-skills for authoring and packaging: a skill creator that interviews the user about purpose, triggers and scripts, a recorder that drafts skills from demonstrations, and the built-in @plugin-creator, which scaffolds plugin.json, MCP wiring and a local marketplace entry for testing. ZIP submission then covers publishing, and a community user corroborates building proprietary skills with the skill-creator skill. Missing for 10: a hands-on demonstration of the full author-to-package flow, and documented validation or testing of authored skills before packaging.
